errorCodes.meaning: The supplied `cursor` is malformed or has expired.

CredentialId.description: Stable identifier for an issued credential — the handle for revocation and audit. Opaque to the holder: it MUST be echoed verbatim when revoking and MUST NOT be parsed.
CredentialId.title: CredentialId

CredentialReference.description:
A pointer to an issued credential, without the credential itself.

The counterpart to IssuedCredential, for the far more common case of *reading about* a credential rather than being handed one. A listing that embedded the signed credential in every row would grow with the size of the credentials rather than the number of them — a page of fifty is megabytes — and a reader that only needs to know a credential exists, when it lapses, and how to revoke it does not need the bytes.

The holder can always fetch the credential itself by `credentialId`, and a verifier can check revocation from the row's status-list slot without either. Reach for IssuedCredential only at the moment of minting, where the caller has no other way to receive what was just made for them.

expiresAt.description: When it lapses, or null when it does not.

CredentialReference.title: CredentialReference

claim.description: The attested claim body — the statement's `credentialSubject.object.value` — validated against the registered predicate's claimSchema when it declares one.

endorsementId.description: Community-scoped identifier for this row. The name is legacy; it identifies a statement, and vtc/endorsements/revoke also takes the `endorsementId` of a role credential issued by vtc/vetting/vetters/grant.

issued.description: A pointer to the issued statement credential — its identifier and lifetime, not its bytes. `endorsements/issue` additionally returns the credential itself, because that is the one call whose caller has no other way to receive it.

revokedAt.description: When the statement was revoked, or null while live.

statusListIndex.description: The statement's slot on the community's shared Revocation status list, referenced by its `credentialStatus`. Published, so a foreign verifier can check revocation without contacting this community.

subjectDid.description: DID of the statement's subject (becomes credentialSubject.id).

typeUri.description: What the row records. A registered predicate IRI: a statement (StatementCredential) whose `credentialSubject.predicate` it is — see vtc/endorsement-types/*. `role:vetter`: a vetter role credential (Verifiable Authority Credential) issued by vtc/vetting/vetters/grant. The reserved value is not an IRI, so it never collides with a registered predicate. A community's own identity check is a statement like any other, under `https://registry.trustoverip.org/dtg/vsc/vetted/1`.

Ext.description: Vendor-namespaced extension object per SPEC.md §4.5.1. Each immediate key MUST be a reverse-DNS namespace; structure under each namespace is opaque to the framework.
Ext.title: Ext

nextCursor.description: Continuation token for the next page; pass it back as `cursor`. Absent on the last page — never `null`.

totalEstimate.description: Approximate total matching endorsements, when the maintainer can cheaply estimate it.

totalEstimate.description: Approximate total matching endorsements, when the maintainer can cheaply estimate it.

cursor.description: An opaque continuation token from a previous response's `nextCursor`; a responder MUST NOT accept a cursor it did not issue.

includeRevoked.description: Include revoked rows. Defaults to true — both live and revoked rows surface; consumers filter on revokedAt.

limit.description: The most items to return, at most 200; the responder chooses a default (50) and MAY return fewer.

subjectDid.description: Filter to endorsements about this subject.

typeUri.description: Filter to rows of this kind: a registered predicate IRI (statements whose `credentialSubject.predicate` it is), or `role:vetter`.
